bugsFoundAndFixedDuringOwnQA: tailwind.config.ts backgroundImage 'dark-hero' mixed a solid color into a background-image gradient list (invalid CSS — background-image cannot carry a trailing color layer); every dark hero section rendered with no background at all, making white hero text/CTAs unreadable on both viewports. Fixed by moving the solid color to bg-ink-950 applied alongside bg-dark-hero everywhere it's used.

SiteHeader used bg-ink-950/92 and several text-*/76 opacity modifiers; Tailwind's default opacity scale only generates modifiers in multiples of 5, so /92 and /76 silently produced no utility (transparent bg / default text color) instead of erroring. Fixed by moving to the nearest supported values (/90, /75).
Both were caught via computed-style inspection during evidence review, not visible in isolation from the code — a general risk worth flagging for any future non-multiple-of-5 opacity value.

playwrightEvidence.evidenceDirNote: QA_ACCEPTANCE.json suggests '{implementationCommit}' as the folder name; the commit hash isn't known until after this receipt's first commit, so a stable branch-scoped name was used instead to avoid a rename/re-capture cycle. playwrightEvidence.note: 'loading' omitted: the contact form's submit round-trip against the local file sink resolves in well under Playwright's screenshot timing window, so no deterministic loading frame could be captured without artificially delaying the API route purely for the screenshot. Functionally the disabled/'Đang gửi...' button state exists in ContactForm.tsx and NewsletterForm.tsx.
